purpose: Pre-registered check for a 32-frame confidence-gated 64-frame fallback

train_observation.interpretation: The tested 32-frame top-1 score and top-1/top-2 margin do not yield a positive, stable train-only fallback rule; dev has no changed rows to validate a threshold.

reason: Current evidence supports retaining B1 as the latency-safe default and reporting static 64-frame sampling as the strongest quality candidate. A conditional fallback requires additional train/dev data or a separately justified observable signal; the fixed 18-row test pool was not used to select a threshold.
